description: Queries where the site ranks 4-20 with above-median impressions, each row carrying the page, position, impressions, CTR and potentialClicks — the click headroom if the page reached the site's own top-position CTR (a site baseline, not an industry curve), best opportunity first. The server does the ranking; do not re-rank by impressions alone. Live GSC read on paid plans, daily-capped; not derivable from the site itself. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_gsc_quick_wins
title: Striking-distance queries with click headroom
